title: insurable_object
description: A real-world thing, person or activity exposed to loss, independent of any policy. Supertype for line-specific objects (vehicle, structure, watercraft, scheduled item, business operation). The same object can be insured on successive or multiple policies.

oneOf.description: Business operations at a location (liability, workers' comp, cyber, professional)
Scheduled personal or business property, equipment, cargo

party_id.description: The person (object type PERSON) or organization (BUSINESS_OPERATION) that is the subject of insurance.

address_id.description: Fixed location of the object, if it has one.

additional_attributes.description: Characteristics of specialty objects with no dedicated subtype entity.
